dashboard.title: dk-data WAL Pressure
dashboard.description: PostgreSQL WAL backpressure telemetry for the prestaged hydration pipeline. Reads meta.wal_pressure (migration 231) via the postgres datasource and dk_wal_source_budget_exhausted_total from Mimir (plan.md §C.2).

panels.title: WAL pressure — current pct_used
panels.description: Live read of meta.wal_pressure.pct_used. Expressed as a percentage of max_wal_size since the last checkpoint. The WAL throttle engages above 70% (high threshold) and releases below 40% (low threshold) — see the panel to the right for historical context.

panels.title: WAL pressure over time
panels.description: Historical pct_used, polled from meta.wal_pressure. The throttle is state-machine-hysteretic: it engages when pct_used crosses 70% upward and releases when pct_used crosses 40% downward (plan §C.2). No Prometheus gauge is emitted for this signal today — the panel queries Postgres directly via the postgres datasource. If the datasource isn't provisioned, this panel shows `No data`.

targets.rawSql: SELECT now() AS time, pct_used FROM meta.wal_pressure

panels.title: Per-source pause-budget exhaustion
panels.description: Rate of dk_wal_source_budget_exhausted_total by source. A non-zero rate means a single source consumed its WAL_PAUSE_BUDGET_PER_SOURCE_SECONDS share and is racing through without backpressure for the rest of the run (other sources still throttle normally). The DkWalSourceBudgetExhausted PrometheusRule pages on any non-zero rate.

panels.title: Hysteresis thresholds
panels.description: Reference values baked into the WAL throttle (src/dk_data/ingestion/wal_throttle.py). The gate transitions state-machine-style: engages when pct_used ≥ high_pct (70%), releases when pct_used ≤ low_pct (40%). Change them by tuning DEFAULT_HIGH_PCT / DEFAULT_LOW_PCT — do NOT narrow the band, hysteresis is what prevents the throttle from oscillating. Values are hard-coded in PromQL (vector()) so this panel does not depend on any emitted metric.

options.content:
### Hysteresis reference

| Threshold | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `high_pct` | **70%** | Throttle engages when `pct_used` crosses this upward |
| `low_pct`  | **40%** | Throttle releases when `pct_used` crosses this downward |

Defaults live in `src/dk_data/ingestion/wal_throttle.py` (`DEFAULT_HIGH_PCT` / `DEFAULT_LOW_PCT`). The 30-point hysteresis band is intentional — narrowing it causes the gate to oscillate under steady load.

### Where data comes from

- **Current pct_used + historical** panels: live `SELECT pct_used FROM meta.wal_pressure` against the platform Postgres via the `postgres` Grafana datasource. The view itself is defined by migration 231. If the datasource is not provisioned in this Grafana instance, the panel shows `No data`; there is no equivalent Prometheus gauge (the throttle reads Postgres directly rather than emitting a gauge — see `src/dk_data/ingestion/wal_throttle.py:wal_pressure`). Emitting a gauge is a TODO if we later need alerting on the signal.
- **Per-source budget exhaustion** panel: `dk_wal_source_budget_exhausted_total` Counter, Mimir-backed.

Spec ref: plan.md §C.2 (feature/005 PR #315, migration 231).
